exposure: Group B: Received clonidine followed by hyperbaric bupivacaine through separate syringes
Sequential administration of clonidine and hyperbaric bupivacaine
Group M: Received a mixture of clonidine and hyperbaric bupivacaine intrathecally
outcome: Time to achieve highest sensory block
Time to achieve complete motor block
cohort: The study included 60 full-term pregnant women scheduled for elective Cesarean section.
finding: Sequential administration of clonidine and hyperbaric bupivacaine resulted in significantly longer duration of analgesia and faster onset of sensory and motor block compared to premixed administration.
